page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text with two diagrams: one above the text, one below it. Diagram labels (letters a, b, c, d, e, ε, αι) are part of the figures and are not transcribed as text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: αἱ κορυφῶν seu fastigiorum anguli fiunt, cum duæ rectæ se inuicem secantes angulos efficiunt quatuor, Quorum bini singuli, qui Vertices seu fastigia ad unum punctum accommodant et in aduersas ipsi partes uergunt, nominantur γωνίαι κορυφῶν, sunt q; per 15 primi elementorum inter se æquales. πεφέρειαι circulorum & lineæ non rectæ mutua sectione non constituunt angulos κορυφῶν æquales quosuis, nec semper. Sed ubi æquales sese circuli per centra interfecant, fiunt æquales fastigiorum anguli bini singuli in quolibet genere, ἀμφίκυρτοι inter se, itá & ἀμφίκοιλοι & μωσοειδεῖς. Vbi uero uel inæquales se secuerint circuli uel æquales non per centra, soli anguli μωσοειδεῖς euadunt æquales, reliqui inter se plurimum discrepant.

page.notes: Figures: an upper diagram of two perpendicular lines with a diagonal ray meeting at a point (labelled a, b, c, d, ε); a lower diagram of two crossing lines (labelled a, b, c, d, ε, and αι at lower right). Greek words are transcribed as legible; the Greek in the second and third lines is partly doubtful and may contain errors, e.g. "πεφέρειαι" and "μωσοειδεῖς" should be checked against the scan.
